candidates.title: [Performance]: Batch-invariant mode on Hopper/Blackwell routes Linear layers to Triton although cuBLAS is already batch-invariant under the mode's settings
candidates.snippet: ### Proposal to improve performance  On SM90 and SM100, `enable_batch_invariant_mode` does not install the Triton matmul overrides. candidates.snippet: `DeepseekV4ForCausalLM.generate(num_beams=3, use_cache=True)` can return different beam candidates from the same model with `use_cache=False`.
